root.purpose: Define the problem and responsibility of a dedicated Agent for Git/GitHub CI and integration across Orchestrator/worker panes, branch/worktree/commit differences and newly discovered ownership/ID/logic dependencies. Common-harness scope includes complete artifact publication, concurrent/lost-update prevention and original/history preservation across source/config proposals, Work/evidence and native apply boundaries.

questionsForFutureInterview: Which failures/delays are actual observed problems and which are hypotheses?
Which ownership/dependency/commit changes can the Agent resolve, and which require accountable Lead or user decision?
What observable useful outcome and Acceptance define solving those problems?

children.scope: Entire common harness and its relevant source/config/Work/evidence/native-owner boundaries
actualProblemQuestions: Which incomplete-publication, lost-update or original-history failures actually exist, and where do existing Git mechanisms already solve them?
Which artifacts/states belong in canonical Git branches/worktrees and which remain private native runtime/credential/session owned?
How should newly discovered ownership/ID/logical dependency conflicts be routed after approval while independent valid work continues?
Which exact-head/tree/transition/consumer checks, expected-ref CAS and review-reuse rules can existing CI enforce?
What bounded native-owner apply/observation remains outside Git; which guarantees are actually needed rather than universal permanent-immutability/full-filesystem-CAS gates?

RootWorkingHypothesis.completePublication: Git immutable commits/trees plus reviewed staged artifacts provide complete candidate identity/publication.
RootWorkingHypothesis.concurrency: Isolated worktrees/branches, explicit ownership, semantic transition checks and expected-ref CAS handle Git-owned updates; detect and route new dependencies.
RootWorkingHypothesis.history: Immutable original refs/commits, evidence and non-replay fences retain observed source history; do not reset/rewrite.
RootWorkingHypothesis.nativeResidual: Branches do not control arbitrary open FDs or shared live private paths; retain bounded existing native-owner apply/permission/observation, never infer native permission from Git.
RootWorkingHypothesis.implementationStatus: Hypothesis/framing only. No new Agent, lock/kernel framework, registry, service or universal prerequisite is approved/implemented.

feedbackProvenance.text: 이제 진행해라. 너는 모든 작업들 맡긴 이후에, 작업 우선순위에 따라서 작업을 진행하면 되는데, 만약 작업할 것이 없으면, 유저와 상의해야할 것들이 있으니까 대기하면 돼. 무엇에 관한 것이냐면 "Git/GitHub 사용하면서, 이렇게 pane 여러개 띄워서 Orchestration 진행하는 경우에, each worktree/branch commit 차이 등등 고려해서 repo에 어떻게 CI 시킬 것인지에 대해서, 전담 Agent 하나를 설계해야하니까, 영향미치는 전반에 대해서 인터뷰해야돼. **"다른 작업 없으면 진행하자는 것이니까, 다른 작업이 있으면 백로그 남기고 나중에 리마인드해라"**
